Both halves of the model now agree on Minnesota: the injury-adjusted sim has the Vikings by 6.5 and real 2026 scoring has them by 7.2, against a market that barely favors them. Justin Jefferson's minor ankle sprain is the main variable; if he practices fully Wednesday this number likely moves toward Minnesota.
